description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_Length' defines an immutable object representing a length measurement with a numeric value and a unit, providing methods for validation, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Length
classes.description: Represents a measurable length with a numeric magnitude and a unit, immutable, with validation and comparison functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new length object with a magnitude and optional unit.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates an HTMLPurifier_Length instance from a string like '2em' or '3.4in'.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the numeric value and unit against CSS 2.1 standards.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the length, e.g., '10px'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the length is valid.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this length with another length, returns 1 if greater, -1 if less, 0 if equal.
